children: Victoria's Secret & Co. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $1.611B, net income attributable to the company of $183M and diluted EPS of $2.18, compared with $1.459B, $16M and $0.2, respectively, in Q2 2025.
Revenue: $1.611B for Q2 2026, up from $1.459B in Q2 2025 (10% YoY).
Net income: $183M attributable to Victoria’s Secret & Co. for Q2 2026, versus $16M in Q2 2025.
Diluted earnings per share: $2.18 for Q2 2026, versus $0.20 in Q2 2025.
Revenue growth: Net sales increased 10% for the quarter and 13% year-to-date, driven by stronger store traffic, higher average unit retail and rising international sales.
Channel shifts: North America stores grew 9% and direct-to-consumer rose 8% in Q2; international sales jumped about 20%, supported by growth in China, royalty streams and a shift of EU fulfillment.
Brand momentum: Victoria’s Secret, PINK and Adore Me showed improved merchandise margins and stronger regular-price selling with reduced promotions.
Operational milestone: The company recognized substantial IEEPA tariff refund recoveries in Q2 2026, which materially improved merchandise margins and gross profit rates.
Execution focus: Continued investments in store experience, technology, logistics and strategic priorities including bra authority, PINK, beauty and go-to-market initiatives.
